response: The biomolecular identification of allergenic pollen presents a new perspective for aerobiological monitoring. According to recent studies, the real-time PCR approach has shown promising results in pollen identification and quantification, even when analyzing pollen mixes. This method has the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of aerobiological monitoring. Future perspectives in this field could involve the development of multiplex real-time PCR for the simultaneous detection of different taxa in the same reaction tube, as well as the application of high-throughput molecular methods. These advancements could enhance our understanding of allergenic pollen and ultimately contribute to better monitoring and management of airborne allergies.
